name: Corpsman: The ABCs of the Dead
source:
My name is Soren, and I'm 27 years old. Six months ago, I got into a car accident and died. That would be the end of the story, but I was resurrected by some mysterious power and given a second chance. 
Now I can hear voices, see what others cannot, and I can't shake the feeling that I am now paying the price for that second chance. 
I didn't want to be saved, and I still don't. However, I have to seek the truth and get to the bottom of this. 

Translated from the [url=https://anivisual.net/stuff/2-1-0-262]official website[/url]
